component.name: deckcheck
component.summary: Friendly health check for your Steam Deck

description.p: deckcheck tells you, in plain English, whether your Steam Deck is healthy, and what to do about it if something is off. No terminal required.

Press one button and it checks the things that actually matter: temperature, processor activity, disk activity, free storage, battery health, the program using your disk the most, and KDE's file indexer (a common cause of a warm, busy Deck at idle). Each result is colour-coded and explained in everyday language.

When something needs attention, deckcheck doesn't just say "investigate", it explains what the thing is, gives step-by-step guidance, and where it's safe, offers a one-click fix. Every fix asks you to confirm first, tells you how to undo it, and only ever does safe, reversible things.

screenshot.caption: deckcheck showing a healthy Steam Deck

description.p: Wording polish across the app's messages. No change to how it works.
Internal quality pass: a unit-tested health-check engine and continuous integration, with no change to how the app looks or behaves.
A wider, two-column window that shows every check at a glance without scrolling, plus the Flatpak sandbox hardening from 0.1.1.

Packaging hardening for Flatpak: the app now runs in a much tighter sandbox (no broad filesystem access), reads sensors directly from the system, and degrades gracefully if its one system-access permission is turned off, the read-only checks keep working and fixes explain how to re-enable access.
First release: seven plain-English health checks with safe, reversible one-click fixes, in a native Qt desktop app.
